# shipd_environment (Data Source)

Look up an existing shipd object by ID or slug without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shipd_project" "app" {
  slug = "my-application"
}

data "shipd_environment" "production" {
  project_id = data.shipd_project.app.id
  slug       = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project containing the environment.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify exactly one of id or slug.
- `slug` (String) Object slug. Specify exactly one of slug or id.

### Read-Only

- `is_production` (Boolean) Whether the environment is production.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Free-form environment classification.
- `version` (Number) Current API object version.
